Overview.Name: Madhusmita Sahoo
Overview.Goal: Support healthy weight gain with simple vegetarian meals focused on whole ingredients. Increase calorie-dense clean foods without increasing salt due to hypertension. Mental wellbeing and stress reduction.

Meal_1_Late_Morning_Breakfast: 3 whole eggs pan fried in ghee + cooked vegetables
OR Paneer (150 to 200g) pan fried in butter + vegetables
OR Curd bowl with fruit + 2 boiled eggs
OR Paneer bhurji cooked in ghee + small portion rice
Add-ons: One fruit (banana or apple) + One spoon ghee mixed into rice or vegetables
Meal_2_Evening_Dinner: OR 3 boiled or pan fried eggs + vegetables + small portion rice
OR Paneer cooked in butter + rice (gluten and soy free)
Snack_Optional_If_Needed: OR Puffed rice mixed with curd
OR A cup of curd with salt and pepper

Notes_and_Tips: For hypertension: avoid pickles, papads, packaged foods and any high-salt snacks. Keep home cooking low salt.
Weight gain goal: eat slightly larger portions of paneer, curd and eggs. Add ghee to meals for safe calorie increase.
Since you have gluten and soy allergies, avoid breads, rotis made from wheat, soya chunks and processed veg foods. Stick to rice-based meals.
In social gatherings: begin with protein first (paneer or eggs) before touching snacks. This reduces overeating and keeps portions controlled.
You handle desserts well, so no special restrictions needed.
Add a short walk after meals to support digestion and blood pressure.
Since you cook for yourself, keep meals simple and repeatable so you don't get decision fatigue.
Use ghee or butter only for cooking. No seed oils.
Drink 2.5L water daily with low-salt cooking for hypertension management.
Focus on calorie-dense whole foods like paneer, eggs, curd, and ghee for healthy weight gain.
